articles.summary: Treasury yields neared their highest level in two decades this week. Borrowing is getting more expensive from two directions at once—a rising Treasury yield, and an expected increase in the Fed Funds Rate. Both land on employers the same way: tighter credit, more caution, slower hiring.
articles.title: Treasury Yields Near 20 Year High: Why That Matters for Labor
